alignments.note: Oath particle: the ASV renders its negative-oath force by *Surely ... not*, one discontinuous rendering under rule 25. Head taken on *Surely*; the competing head is *not*, which carries the negation the particle implies.
Finite verb with subject pronoun and auxiliary (rule 17), headed on the lexical verb; discontinuous around the oath particle's *not*.
Construct noun with the supplied *the* rule 29 allows where no article morpheme stands.
Nomen rectum with the chain's *of* (rule 19), discontinuous around the possessive.
Second oath particle rendered *Nor*, carrying both the coordination and the negation (rule 35).
Verb with its phrasal particle *up* (rule 44); the ASV writes no separate subject pronoun in this gapped colon.

`עֶרֶשׂ יְצוּעָי` is rendered by the single word *bed*, which carries both morphemes' sense, so they share one unit under rule 30; headed on `יְצוּעַ`, whose lexeme the English word writes. The ASV's own margin (*Hebrew the couch of my bed*) corroborates the single rendering and decides nothing, by rule 38. The competing analysis marks `עֶרֶשׂ` unrepresented, which rule 30 forbids.

review_notes: Both `אִם` particles are oath negatives; the first takes *Surely ... not* and the second the fused *Nor*.
The margin's literal glosses were read and set aside under rule 38.
